snippet.title: Blue Ridge Hunting Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game where you and your friends investigate, document, and hunt cryptids in the Appalachian Mountains.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434930/Blue_Ridge_Hunting/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
